- We have a company-wide limited-support window the week of Nov 29 as several teams are prioritizing conference commitments.

Given that, I'd like to propose two options so we don't risk a light-handed workshop:

1) Move to Mon, Dec 6, 10:00 AM PT — same agenda, full SE + integration engineer in attendance.
2) Keep Nov 29 but split into two 45-minute sessions (Rishi covers product + roadmap; Tessa provides recorded deep-dive and live Q&A later).

If neither works, Dec 13 is also open. Which would you prefer? We'll hold the Nov 29 slot for 48 hours pending your reply.

Also looping in Soojin (CS ops) to coordinate handoffs and calendar invites.
